theorem CycleBridgePath.cycle_of_arc
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V}

name: Erdos64.CycleBridgePath.cycle_of_extracted_arc
statement:
theorem CycleBridgePath.cycle_of_extracted_arc
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableEq V] {s : V}
    {cycle : G.Walk s s}
    (bridge : CycleBridgePath G cycle)
    {p : G.Path bridge.left bridge.right}
    {q : G.Path bridge.right bridge.left}
    (hdecomp :
      (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).append
          (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left) =
        cycle.rotate bridge.left bridge.left_mem_cycle)
    (hlength :
      1 < bridge.path.length ∨
        1 < (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.left,
      c.IsCycle ∧ c.length =
        bridge.path.length + (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length

name: Erdos64.CycleBridgePath.exists_of_connected_external_neighbor
statement:
theorem CycleBridgePath.exists_of_connected_external_neighbor
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s a x : V}
    {cycle : G.Walk s s} (hcycle : cycle.IsCycle)
    (hconn : G.Connected) (ha : a ∈ cycle.support)
    (hx : x ∉ cycle.support) (hax : G.Adj a x) :
    (∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G cycle, bridge.left = a) ∨
      ∃ (p : G.Walk x a) (i : ℕ),
        p.IsPath ∧ 0 < i ∧ i ≤ p.length ∧ p.getVert i = a ∧
          (p.take i).support.dropLast.Disjoint cycle.support

    (hdecomp :
      (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).append
          (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left) =

    (hp :

name: Erdos64.ShortestCycleCertificate.exists_attachment_or_same_return
statement:
theorem ShortestCycleCertificate.exists_attachment_or_same_return
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (certificate : ShortestCycleCertificate G)
    (hconn : G.Connected)
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    {a : V} (ha : a ∈ certificate.cycle.support) :
    ∃ x, G.Adj a x ∧ x ∉ certificate.cycle.support ∧
      ((∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G certificate.cycle,
          bridge.left = a) ∨
       ∃ (p : G.Walk x a) (i : ℕ),
          p.IsPath ∧ 0 < i ∧ i ≤ p.length ∧
            p.getVert i = a ∧
            (p.take i).support.dropLast.Disjoint certificate.cycle.support)

statement:
theorem ShortestCycleCertificate.exists_degree_three_bridge_or_excursion
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (certificate : ShortestCycleCertificate G)
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (hconn : G.Connected)
    (hmin : G.minDegree ≥ 3)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ certificate.cycle.support)
    (hvhigh : 4 ≤ G.degree v) :
    ∃ w, G.Adj v w ∧ w ∉ certificate.cycle.support ∧
      G.degree w = 3 ∧
      ((∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G certificate.cycle,
          bridge.left = v) ∨
       (∃ (p : G.Walk w v) (i : ℕ),
          p.IsPath ∧ 0 < i ∧ i ≤ p.length ∧
            p.getVert i = v ∧
            (p.take i).support.dropLast.Disjoint certificate.cycle.support ∧
            ((∃ c : G.Walk v v, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = i + 1) ∨
              i = 1)))

          certificate.p + certificate.alpha + certificate.beta = 2 ^ k ∨
          certificate.p + certificate.gamma + certificate.delta = 2 ^ k ∨
          certificate.q + certificate.beta + certificate.gamma = 2 ^ k ∨
          certificate.q + certificate.delta + certificate.alpha = 2 ^ k ∨

    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {s v w : V} {cycle : G.Walk s s}
    (hcycle : cycle.IsCycle)
    (hv : v ∈ cycle.support) (hw : w ∉ cycle.support)
    (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hwdeg : G.degree w = 3) :
    (∃ x, x ∈ cycle.support ∧ x ≠ v ∧ G.Adj w x ∧
      ∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G cycle,
        bridge.left = v ∧ bridge.right = x) ∨
    (∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj w x ∧ G.Adj w y ∧
      x ≠ v ∧ y ≠ v ∧ x ∉ cycle.support ∧ y ∉ cycle.support)

name: Erdos64.two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting
statement:
theorem two_cubic_ports_boundary_accounting
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3) :
    internalDegree G D x = 2 ∧
    internalDegree G D y = 2 ∧
    (∀ v, v ∈ D → v ≠ x → v ≠ y →
      internalDegree G D v = G.degree v) ∧
    (D.filter (G.Adj r)).card = 2

    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ z w, z ∈ D ∧ w ∈ D ∧
      z ≠ r ∧ z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ y ∧ G.Adj x z ∧
      w ≠ r ∧ w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y ∧ G.Adj y w

statement:
theorem separated_third_neighbor_component_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}

    (D : Finset V) (r x y z w : V)

    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ t, t ∉ D → G.Adj v t → t = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hxy : G.Adj x y)
    (hz : z ∈ D ∧ z ≠ r ∧ z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ y ∧ G.Adj x z)
    (hw : w ∈ D ∧ w ≠ r ∧ w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y ∧ G.Adj y w)
    (hzw : z ≠ w)
    (hzw_adj : ¬G.Adj z w) :
    (∃ C : (G.induce (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V)).ConnectedComponent,
      (⟨z, (show z ∈ (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V) from by
        simpa [hz.2.2.1, hz.2.2.2.1] using hz.1)⟩ :
        (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V)) ∈ C.supp ∧
      (⟨w, (show w ∈ (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V) from by
        simpa [hw.2.2.1, hw.2.2.2.1] using hw.1)⟩ :
        (↑(D.erase x |>.erase y) : Set V)) ∈ C.supp) ∨
    ∃ K : Finset V,
      z ∈ K ∧ K ⊆ D ∧ K ⊂ D ∧
      w ∉ K ∧ x ∉ K ∧ y ∉ K ∧
      (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).Connected ∧
      (∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = x)

name: Erdos64.separated_third_neighbor_cycle
statement:
theorem separated_third_neighbor_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}

name: Erdos64.separated_third_neighbor_path

theorem separated_third_neighbor_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {D : Set V}

name: Erdos64.three_terminal_paths_cycle_spectrum
statement:
theorem three_terminal_paths_cycle_spectrum
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V}
    (p q t : G.Walk a b)
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath) (ht : t.IsPath)
    (hpq : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ q.support → z = a ∨ z = b)
    (hqt : ∀ z, z ∈ q.support → z ∈ t.support → z = a ∨ z = b)
    (htp : ∀ z, z ∈ t.support → z ∈ p.support → z = a ∨ z = b)
    (hpLength : 1 < p.length)
    (hqLength : 1 < q.length)
    (htLength : 1 < t.length) :
    ((p.append q.reverse).IsCycle ∧
      (p.append q.reverse).length = p.length + q.length ∧
      (p.append q.reverse).support = p.support ++ q.support.reverse.tail) ∧
    ((q.append t.reverse).IsCycle ∧
      (q.append t.reverse).length = q.length + t.length ∧
      (q.append t.reverse).support = q.support ++ t.support.reverse.tail) ∧
    ((t.append p.reverse).IsCycle ∧
      (t.append p.reverse).length = t.length + p.length ∧
      (t.append p.reverse).support = t.support ++ p.support.reverse.tail)

name: Erdos64.three_terminal_paths_no_dyadic_lengths
statement:
theorem three_terminal_paths_no_dyadic_lengths
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r a b : V}

    (htp : ∀ z, z ∈ t.support → z ∈ p.support → z = a ∨ z = b)
    (hpLength : 1 < p.length)
    (hqLength : 1 < q.length)
    (htLength : 1 < t.length)
    (hrootp : r ∉ p.support)
    (hrootq : r ∉ q.support)
    (hroott : r ∉ t.support)
    (hra : G.Adj r a)
    (hrb : G.Adj r b)
    (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
      (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → q.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
      (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → t.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
      (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + q.length ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
      (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → q.length + t.length ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
      (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → t.length + p.length ≠ 2 ^ k)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_path_cycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_path_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ t, t ∉ D → G.Adj v t → t = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ (z w : V) (p : G.Walk z w) (c : G.Walk x x),
      z ∈ D ∧ w ∈ D ∧ z ≠ w ∧ ¬G.Adj z w ∧
      G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y w ∧ p.IsPath ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y) ∧
      c.IsCycle ∧ r ∈ c.support ∧ c.length = p.length + 4

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_path_no_dyadic
statement:

    (hxy : G.Adj x y) :

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_cubic_two_ports_two_cycles
statement:

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_degree_two_ports_pow_two_add_one_path

    (hno : ¬HasPowerOfTwoCycle H)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_two_defect_pow_two_add_one_path

theorem MinimalCounterexample.adjacent_two_defect_pow_two_add_one_path

name: Erdos64.SevenLengthArithmetic.exists_dyadic_entry
statement:
theorem SevenLengthArithmetic.exists_dyadic_entry
    (s : SevenLengthArithmetic)
    (h : ∃ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k ∧ 2 ^ k ∈ s.lengths) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k ∧
      (s.n = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.p + s.alpha + s.beta = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.p + s.gamma + s.delta = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.q + s.beta + s.gamma = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.q + s.delta + s.alpha = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.p + s.q + s.gamma + s.alpha = 2 ^ k ∨
        s.p + s.q + s.beta + s.delta = 2 ^ k)

name: Erdos64.SevenLengthArithmetic.mem_lengths_iff
statement:
theorem SevenLengthArithmetic.mem_lengths_iff
    (s : SevenLengthArithmetic) (x : ℕ) :
    x ∈ s.lengths ↔
      x = s.n ∨
      x = s.p + s.alpha + s.beta ∨
      x = s.p + s.gamma + s.delta ∨
      x = s.q + s.beta + s.gamma ∨
      x = s.q + s.delta + s.alpha ∨
      x = s.p + s.q + s.gamma + s.alpha ∨
      x = s.p + s.q + s.beta + s.delta

name: Erdos64.root_cycle_correspondence_length
statement:

statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.nonadjacent_terminal_cross_path
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {a b : V} (hab : a ≠ b) (hnadj : ¬G.Adj a b)

name: Erdos64.quotient_path_lift_of_avoids_none

name: Erdos64.residual_path_root_internal_split
statement:
theorem residual_path_root_internal_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {r u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hp : p.IsPath) (hru : u ≠ r) (hrv : v ≠ r)
    (hrp : r ∈ p.support) :
    ∃ (a : G.Walk u r) (b : G.Walk r v),
      a.IsPath ∧ b.IsPath ∧
      a.append b = p ∧
      a.support ⊆ p.support ∧ b.support ⊆ p.support ∧
      a.length + b.length = p.length ∧
      0 < a.length ∧ 0 < b.length ∧
      r ∉ a.support.dropLast ∧ r ∉ b.support.tail

theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_port_side_dyadic_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}

    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hboundary : ∀ a, a ∈ D → ∀ b, b ∉ D → G.Adj a b → b = r)
    (hports : ∀ a, a ∈ D → G.Adj a r → a = x ∨ a = y) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,

    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hnonadj : ∀ a b,
      a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      b ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      G.Adj r a → G.Adj r b → a ≠ b → ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    ∃ x y : V, ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
      x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y ∧
      2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧

        a ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧ r ∉ q.support

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_cubic_two_port_case_split
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.exact_cubic_two_port_case_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D) (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : G.degree x = 3 ∧ G.degree y = 3)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r) :
    (G.Adj x y ∧
        ∃ (z w : V) (p : G.Walk z w),
          z ∈ D ∧ w ∈ D ∧ z ≠ w ∧ ¬G.Adj z w ∧
          G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y w ∧ p.IsPath ∧
          (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y) ∧
          (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 3 ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
          (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 4 ≠ 2 ^ k)) ∨
      (¬G.Adj x y ∧
        ∃ (k : ℕ) (q : G.Walk x y),
          2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
          (∀ v, v ∈ q.support → v ∈ D) ∧ r ∉ q.support)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_twoPort_component_cubic_case_split
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_twoPort_component_cubic_case_split

    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hcard : (rootDeletedComponentAttachments G r C).card = 2)
    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r)
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C →
      G.Adj v r → G.degree v = 3) :
    (∃ x y : V, ∃ z w : V, ∃ p : G.Walk z w,
        x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
        y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
        x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y ∧ G.Adj x y ∧
        z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
        w ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ z ≠ w ∧ ¬G.Adj z w ∧
        G.Adj x z ∧ G.Adj y w ∧ p.IsPath ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ≠ r ∧ v ≠ x ∧ v ≠ y) ∧
        (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 3 ≠ 2 ^ k) ∧
        (∀ k, 2 ≤ k → p.length + 4 ≠ 2 ^ k)) ∨
      (∃ x y : V, ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ q : G.Walk x y,
        x ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
        y ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ x ≠ y ∧
        G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y ∧ ¬G.Adj x y ∧
        2 ≤ k ∧ q.IsPath ∧ q.length = 2 ^ k ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ q.support →
          v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) ∧ r ∉ q.support)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.shared_root_residual_path_of_quotient_root_degree
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.shared_root_residual_path_of_quotient_root_degree
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {r x y : V}

    (hroot_degree : 4 ≤ G.degree r) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ u v : V, ∃ p : G.Walk u v,
      k ≥ 2 ∧
      p.IsPath ∧

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_two_cubic_port_side_dyadic_successor_cycle

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.exact_adjacent_cubic_side_pow_two_add_one_path

name: Erdos64.two_pole_cubic_even_order
statement:
theorem two_pole_cubic_even_order

    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.degree v = 3) :
    2 * (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card + 2 = 3 * D.card ∧
      Even D.card

name: Erdos64.balanced_two_cubic_poles_force_odd_ambient_order
statement:
theorem balanced_two_cubic_poles_force_odd_ambient_order

    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.degree v = 3)
    (hDE : Disjoint D E)
    (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hpartition : (D ∪ E) ∪ ({r} : Finset V) = Finset.univ)

    Even D.card ∧ Fintype.card V = 2 * D.card + 1

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.boundary_root_erase_has_dyadic_cycle
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.boundary_root_erase_has_dyadic_cycle

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.carrier_boundary_path_avoiding
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.carrier_boundary_path_avoiding
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (t : {v : V // v ∈ K}) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : {v : V // v ∈ K},
      ∃ p : (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).Walk a b,
        2 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K ∧
        b ∈ carrierBoundaryVertices G K ∧ a ≠ t ∧ b ≠ t ∧
        a ≠ b ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.carrier_dyadic_ear_avoiding_unique_attachment
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.carrier_dyadic_ear_avoiding_unique_attachment
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (S : Set V)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ S)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (hB : 4 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (t : {v : V // v ∈ K}) (s : V) (hs : s ∈ S)
    (hunique : ∀ v, v ∈ K → G.Adj v s → v = t.1) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      2 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨ v ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ S → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      s ∉ ear.support

name: Erdos64.closed_sides_edge_count
statement:
theorem closed_sides_edge_count
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}

    (hclosedB : ∀ x, x ∈ B → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ B) :

name: Erdos64.cutComponent_to_leafBlockCarrier
statement:
theorem cutComponent_to_leafBlockCarrier
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (K R : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hKnonempty : K.Nonempty)
    (hrR : r ∈ R)
    (hpartition : K ∪ R = (Finset.univ : Finset V))
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint K R)
    (hRother : ∃ z, z ∈ R ∧ z ≠ r)
    (hblockconn :
      (G.induce (↑({r} ∪ K) : Set V)).Connected)
    (hnoncross :
      ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∈ R → y ≠ r → ¬G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ S : Finset V,
      S = {r} ∪ K ∧
      S.Nonempty ∧
      S ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset V) ∧
      r ∈ S ∧
      (∃ x, x ∈ S ∧ x ≠ r) ∧
      (G.induce (↑S : Set V)).Connected ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ S → ∀ y, y ∉ S → G.Adj x y → x = r) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ S → x ≠ r → ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ S)

    (hconnectors :

      2 ≤ H.card →
        (L.filter (fun v => (H.filter (G.Adj v)).card = 2)).card + 3 ≤
          2 * H.card) :

      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => G.degree v = 3)).card ∧

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.carrier_dyadic_ear_of_three_boundary
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.carrier_dyadic_ear_of_three_boundary
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (S : Set V)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ S)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hsingle : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ a, a ∉ K → ∀ b, b ∉ K →
      G.Adj v a → G.Adj v b → a = b)
    (hB : 3 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      2 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨ v ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ S → v = a ∨ v = b)

statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_component_dyadic_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨
        v ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)

name: Erdos64.mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_offPathComponentCarrier_iff
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V) {x y : V} (p : G.Walk x y)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ A ∧ v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent) (v : V) :

theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_spanning_cubic_path_matching
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (hspan : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → v ∈ p.support)
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C → G.degree v = 3) :
    Odd p.length ∧
      ∃ q : (G.induce (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)).Walk
          ⟨x, hinside x p.start_mem_support⟩ ⟨y, hinside y p.end_mem_support⟩,
        q.map (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce
          (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)).toHom = p ∧
        q.IsPath ∧ (∀ v, v ∈ q.support) ∧
        ((G.induce (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)).toSubgraph
          ((G.induce (↑(rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) : Set V)) \
            q.toSubgraph.spanningCoe) sdiff_le).IsPerfectMatching

        q.map (SimpleGraph.Embedding.induce (↑D : Set V)).toHom = p ∧

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.small_carrier_dyadic_ear_avoiding_unique_attachment
statement:

    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}

    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (S : Set V)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∉ S)
    (hboundary : ∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hB : 4 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G K).card)
    (hsize : 2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (t : {v : V // v ∈ K}) (s : V) (hs : s ∈ S)
    (hunique : ∀ v, v ∈ K → G.Adj v s → v = t.1) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ^ k ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨ v ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ S → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      s ∉ ear.support

statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_dyadic_ear_avoiding_cubic_path_vertex
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}

    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)

      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧

name: Erdos64.cut_side_offPath_carrier_data
statement:
theorem cut_side_offPath_carrier_data
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}

    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent) :
    let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
    K.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ K → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧ v ∉ p.support) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj v w → w ∈ p.support) ∧
      2 * K.card + 1 < Fintype.card V

name: Erdos64.equal_cut_root_balanced_excess
statement:
theorem equal_cut_root_balanced_excess
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (A B : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hpartition : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hinter : A ∩ B = ({r} : Finset V))
    (hrootA : r ∈ A) (hrootB : r ∈ B)
    (hclosedA : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ A)
    (hclosedB : ∀ x, x ∈ B → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, G.Adj x y → y ∈ B)
    (hnocross : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, y ∈ B → y ≠ r → ¬ G.Adj x y)
    (hrootDegreeA : 2 ≤ internalDegree G A r)
    (hrootDegreeB : 2 ≤ internalDegree G B r)
    (hcard : A.card = B.card)
    (hedges :
      (G.induce (↑A : Set V)).edgeFinset.card =
        (G.induce (↑B : Set V)).edgeFinset.card) :
    internalDegree G A r = 2 ∧
      internalDegree G B r = 2 ∧
      G.degree r = 4 ∧
      (∀ v, G.Adj r v → G.degree v = 3) ∧
      nonrootDegreeExcess G A r = nonrootDegreeExcess G B r

    (hsize : 2 * Fintype.card W + 1 < Fintype.card V)
    (hno : ¬ HasPowerOfTwoCycle H) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : W, ∃ p : H.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ B ∧ b ∈ B ∧ a ≠ b ∧ p.IsPath ∧
      (p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k ∨ p.length + 2 = 2 ^ k + 1)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_mixed_ear_avoiding_vertex_of_cubic_path
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_cut_side_mixed_ear_avoiding_vertex_of_cubic_path
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hB : 3 ≤ (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card)
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → G.degree v = 3)
    (s : V) (hs : s ∈ p.support) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      1 ≤ k ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      ear.IsPath ∧ (ear.length = 2 ^ k ∨ ear.length = 2 ^ k + 1) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v = a ∨ v = b ∨
        v ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E) ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ p.support → v = a ∨ v = b) ∧
      s ∉ ear.support ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ ear.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)

    (∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G C, True) ∨

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_bridge_branch_cycle_length_certificate
statement:
theorem externalComponent_bridge_branch_cycle_length_certificate
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {s : V}
    [DecidableEq V] {C : G.Walk s s} (hC : C.IsCycle)
    (hbridge : ∃ bridge : CycleBridgePath G C, True) :
    ∃ (bridge : CycleBridgePath G C)
      (p : G.Path bridge.left bridge.right)
      (q : G.Path bridge.right bridge.left),
      (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).append
          (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left) =
        C.rotate bridge.left bridge.left_mem_cycle ∧
      (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length +
          (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length = C.length ∧
      ((p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length > 1 ∨
        (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length > 1) ∧
      ((∃ c : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.left,
          c.IsCycle ∧
            c.length = bridge.path.length +
              (p : G.Walk bridge.left bridge.right).length) ∨
       (∃ c : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.right,
          c.IsCycle ∧
            c.length = bridge.path.length +
              (q : G.Walk bridge.right bridge.left).length))

name: Erdos64.externalComponent_exists_rootedBranchCarrier

theorem externalComponent_exists_rootedBranchCarrier

    (hroot : ∀ b, b ∈ C.support →
      ((∃ v, v ∈ externalComponent G C x hx ∧ G.Adj b v) ↔ b = r)) :
    let K : Set V := externalComponent G C x hx
    ∃ B : RootedBranchCarrier G,
      B.carrier = K.toFinset ∧ B.root = r ∧
      (∀ v, v ∈ B.carrier → v ∉ C.support) ∧

name: Erdos64.rootedDouble_degree_order_interface
statement:
theorem rootedDouble_degree_order_interface
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (S : Finset V) (r : {v : V // v ∈ S})
    (hclosed : ∀ v, v ∈ S → v ≠ r.val →
      ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ S)
    (hroot : 2 ≤ internalDegree G S r.val)
    (hside : ∀ v, v ∈ S → 3 ≤ G.degree v)
    (hsize : 2 * S.card - 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    (∀ (b : Bool) (v : {v : (↑S : Set V) // v ≠ r}),
      3 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) r).degree
        (some (b, v))) ∧
    4 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑S : Set V)) r).degree none ∧
    Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑S : Set V) r) = 2 * S.card - 1 ∧
    Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑S : Set V) r) < Fintype.card V

      3 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑side.S : Set V)) side.root).degree
        (some (b, v))) ∧
    4 ≤ (rootedDoubleGraph (G.induce (↑side.S : Set V)) side.root).degree none ∧
    Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑side.S : Set V) side.root) =
      2 * side.S.card - 1 ∧
    Fintype.card (RootedDoubleVertex (↑side.S : Set V) side.root) <
      Fintype.card V

    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    (G.induce (↑(insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)) : Set V)).edgeFinset.card =
        (G.induce (↑(insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D)) : Set V)).edgeFinset.card ∧
      nonrootDegreeExcess G (insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)) r =
        nonrootDegreeExcess G (insert r (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r D)) r

name: Erdos64.GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.two_onePort_sides_balanced_edges_excess
statement:
theorem GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample.two_onePort_sides_balanced_edges_excess
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : GlobalEdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (D E : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hD : D.Nonempty) (hE : E.Nonempty)

    (hdisj : Disjoint D E)
    (hboundaryD : ∀ u, u ∈ D → ∀ v, v ∉ D → G.Adj u v → v = r)
    (hboundaryE : ∀ u, u ∈ E → ∀ v, v ∉ E → G.Adj u v → v = r) :
    (G.induce (↑(insert r D) : Set V)).edgeFinset.card =
        (G.induce (↑(insert r E) : Set V)).edgeFinset.card ∧
      nonrootDegreeExcess G (insert r D) r =
        nonrootDegreeExcess G (insert r E) r

theorem exists_simple_marked_root_path

    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ p : G.Walk x y,

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cycle_of_first_reunion
statement:
theorem SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cycle_of_first_reunion
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {w z : V}
    (p q : G.Walk w z) (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath)
    (hfirst : p.snd ≠ q.snd) {i j : ℕ}
    (hi_pos : 0 < i) (hi_le : i ≤ p.length)
    (hj_pos : 0 < j) (hj_le : j ≤ q.length)
    (hmeet : p.getVert i = q.getVert j)
    (hdisjoint :
      (p.take i).support.tail.Disjoint
        (q.take j).reverse.support.tail) :
    ∃ c : G.Walk w w, c.IsCycle ∧
      c.length = i + j ∧ c.length ≤ p.length + q.length

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_odd_low_boundary_component_two_edge_ear
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_odd_low_boundary_component_two_edge_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hinside : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {z : V | z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      z ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hKodd : Odd (offPathComponentCarrier G
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E).card)
    (hodddegrees : ∀ v, v ∈ offPathComponentCarrier G
      (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E → Odd (G.degree v))
    (hB : (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card ≤ 2) :
    let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
    ∃ u a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      u ∈ K ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      G.Adj u a ∧ G.Adj u b ∧ ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z ∈ p.support → z = a ∨ z = b)

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_one_boundary_component_three_attachment_fan
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_one_boundary_component_three_attachment_fan
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y)
    (hinside : ∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (E : (G.induce {v : V | v ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      v ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hB : (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card ≤ 1) :
    ∃ t a b c : V,
      offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E = {t} ∧
      t ∉ p.support ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ c ∈ p.support ∧
      a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c ∧ G.Adj t a ∧ G.Adj t b ∧ G.Adj t c

name: Erdos64.SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.onePort_cycle_excursion
statement:
theorem SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle.onePort_cycle_excursion
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {s : V} {c : G.Walk s s} (hc : c.IsCycle)
    (x : V) (hxcycle : x ∈ c.support)
    (K : Finset V) (hx : x ∉ K)
    (hbd :
      ∀ u, u ∈ K → ∀ v, v ∉ K → G.Adj u v → v = x)
    (hmeet : ∃ v, v ∈ c.support ∧ v ∈ K) :
    ∃ a b : V, a ∈ K ∧ b ∈ K ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      G.Adj x a ∧ G.Adj b x ∧
      ∃ p : G.Walk a b,
        p.IsPath ∧
        (∀ v, v ∈ p.support → v ∈ K) ∧
        c.length = p.length + 2

    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (root : V)
    (hnonroot : ∃ x, x ∈ K ∧ x ≠ root)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∉ K → G.Adj x y → x = root) :

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.connectedOnePortCarrier_cubic_port_degree_split
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.connectedOnePortCarrier_cubic_port_degree_split
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (K : Finset V) (root : V)
    (hKconn : (G.induce (↑K : Set V)).Connected)
    (hKnonempty : K.Nonempty)
    (hKproper : K ≠ (Finset.univ : Finset V))
    (hroot : root ∈ K)
    (hnonroot : ∃ x, x ∈ K ∧ x ≠ root)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ x, x ∈ K → ∀ y, y ∉ K → G.Adj x y → x = root)
    (hdegree : G.degree root = 3) :
    1 ≤ (K.filter (G.Adj root)).card ∧
      (K.filter (G.Adj root)).card ≤ 2 ∧
      1 ≤ internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K.erase root) root ∧
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K.erase root) root ≤ 2 ∧
      internalDegree G (Finset.univ \ K.erase root) root +
          (K.filter (G.Adj root)).card = 3

name: Erdos64.terminal_path_reroute_of_ear
statement:
theorem terminal_path_reroute_of_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x)
    (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b)
    (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (hpre : pre.IsPath)
    (hsegment : segment.IsPath)
    (hsuffix : suffix.IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath)
    (hprefix_segment :
      pre.support.Disjoint segment.support.tail)
    (hsegment_ear :
      segment.support.tail.Disjoint ear.reverse.support.tail)
    (horiginal_suffix :
      (pre.append segment).support.Disjoint suffix.support.tail)
    (hrerouted_prefix :
      pre.support.Disjoint ear.support.tail)
    (hrerouted_suffix :
      (pre.append ear).support.Disjoint suffix.support.tail)
    (hlong : 1 < segment.length ∨ 1 < ear.length) :
    ∃ rerouted : G.Walk a b, rerouted.IsPath ∧
      rerouted.length =
        pre.length + ear.length + suffix.length ∧
      ∃ cycle : G.Walk x x, cycle.IsCycle ∧
        cycle.length = segment.length + ear.length

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.cross_residual_root_internal_excursions_nondyadic
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.cross_residual_root_internal_excursions_nondyadic
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    {r x y u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v}
    (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (hp : p.IsPath)
    (havoid : ∀ w, w ∈ p.support → w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y)
    (hru : u ≠ r) (hrv : v ≠ r)
    (hrp : r ∈ p.support)

      (G.Adj y u ∧ G.Adj x v)) :

      a.IsPath ∧ b.IsPath ∧ a.append b = p ∧
      a.support ⊆ p.support ∧ b.support ⊆ p.support ∧
      a.length + b.length = p.length ∧
      0 < a.length ∧ 0 < b.length ∧
      r ∉ a.support.dropLast ∧ r ∉ b.support.tail ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → a.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ j) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → b.length + 2 ≠ 2 ^ j)

statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.rootDeleted_two_boundary_component_fork_or_ear_spectrum
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G) (r : V)
    (C D : (G.induce {v : V | v ≠ r}).ConnectedComponent) (hCD : C ≠ D)
    {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hrx : G.Adj r x) (hry : G.Adj r y)
    (p : G.Walk x y) (hp : p.IsPath)
    (hinside : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C)
    (hcubic : ∀ z, z ∈ p.support → G.degree z = 3)
    (E : (G.induce {z : V | z ∈ rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C ∧
      z ∉ p.support}).ConnectedComponent)
    (hB : (carrierBoundaryVertices G
      (offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E)).card = 2) :
    let K := offPathComponentCarrier G (rootDeletedComponentCarrier G r C) p E
    (∃ u a b : V, ∃ ear : G.Walk a b,
      u ∈ K ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      G.Adj u a ∧ G.Adj u b ∧ ear.IsPath ∧ ear.length = 2 ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ ear.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K)) ∨
    (∃ u v a b : V,
      u ∈ K ∧ v ∈ K ∧ u ≠ v ∧ a ∈ p.support ∧ b ∈ p.support ∧ a ≠ b ∧
      G.Adj u a ∧ G.Adj v b ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ K → ∀ w, w ∉ K → G.Adj z w →
        (z = u ∧ w = a) ∨ (z = v ∧ w = b)) ∧
      ∃ i j : ℕ, ∃ evenEar oddEar : G.Walk a b,
        1 ≤ i ∧ 1 ≤ j ∧ evenEar.IsPath ∧ oddEar.IsPath ∧
        evenEar.length = 2 ^ i ∧ oddEar.length = 2 ^ j + 1 ∧
        (∀ z, z ∈ evenEar.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K) ∧
        (∀ z, z ∈ oddEar.support → z = a ∨ z = b ∨ z ∈ K))

statement:
theorem terminal_path_equal_length_exchange_of_two_disjoint_fresh_ears
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x₁) (segment₁ : G.Walk x₁ y₁)
    (middle : G.Walk y₁ x₂) (segment₂ : G.Walk x₂ y₂)
    (suffix : G.Walk y₂ b)
    (ear₁ : G.Walk x₁ y₁) (ear₂ : G.Walk x₂ y₂)
    (horiginal :
      ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear₁ : ear₁.IsPath) (hear₂ : ear₂.IsPath)
    (hxy₁ : x₁ ≠ y₁) (hxy₂ : x₂ ≠ y₂)
    (hfresh₁ : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₁.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support →
      z = x₁ ∨ z = y₁)
    (hfresh₂ : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₂.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support →
      z = x₂ ∨ z = y₂)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₁.support → z ∈ ear₂.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support)
    (hbalance : ear₁.length + ear₂.length = segment₁.length + segment₂.length) :
    ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append ear₂).append suffix).IsPath ∧
      ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append ear₂).append suffix).length =
        ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).length

name: Erdos64.terminal_path_reroute_isPath_of_fresh_ear
statement:
theorem terminal_path_reroute_isPath_of_fresh_ear
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x y : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x) (segment : G.Walk x y)
    (suffix : G.Walk y b) (ear : G.Walk x y)
    (horiginal : ((pre.append segment).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear : ear.IsPath) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hfresh : ∀ z, z ∈ ear.support →
      z ∈ ((pre.append segment).append suffix).support → z = x ∨ z = y) :
    ((pre.append ear).append suffix).IsPath

name: Erdos64.terminal_path_reroute_of_two_disjoint_fresh_ears
statement:
theorem terminal_path_reroute_of_two_disjoint_fresh_ears
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : V}
    (pre : G.Walk a x₁) (segment₁ : G.Walk x₁ y₁)
    (middle : G.Walk y₁ x₂) (segment₂ : G.Walk x₂ y₂)
    (suffix : G.Walk y₂ b)
    (ear₁ : G.Walk x₁ y₁) (ear₂ : G.Walk x₂ y₂)
    (horiginal :
      ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).IsPath)
    (hear₁ : ear₁.IsPath) (hear₂ : ear₂.IsPath)
    (hxy₁ : x₁ ≠ y₁) (hxy₂ : x₂ ≠ y₂)
    (hfresh₁ : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₁.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support →
      z = x₁ ∨ z = y₁)
    (hfresh₂ : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₂.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support →
      z = x₂ ∨ z = y₂)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ z, z ∈ ear₁.support → z ∈ ear₂.support →
      z ∈ ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).support) :
    ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append ear₂).append suffix).IsPath ∧
      ((((pre.append ear₁).append middle).append ear₂).append suffix).length +
          (segment₁.length + segment₂.length) =
        ((((pre.append segment₁).append middle).append segment₂).append suffix).length +
          (ear₁.length + ear₂.length)

name: Erdos64.balanced_two_cubic_poles_force_odd_ambient_order_of_complement_balanced
statement:
theorem balanced_two_cubic_poles_force_odd_ambient_order_of_complement_balanced
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hrD : r ∉ D) (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexact :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = x ∨ v = y))
    (hcubic : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.degree v = 3)
    (hbalanced : D.card = (Finset.univ \ (D ∪ ({r} : Finset V))).card) :
    Even D.card ∧ Fintype.card V = 2 * D.card + 1

name: Erdos64.equal_induced_edge_count_of_equal_two_pole_card
statement:
theorem equal_induced_edge_count_of_equal_two_pole_card
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (D E : Finset V)
    (r xD yD xE yE : V)
    (hrD : r ∉ D)
    (hportsD : xD ∈ D ∧ yD ∈ D ∧ xD ≠ yD)
    (hboundaryD :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexactD :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = xD ∨ v = yD))
    (hcubicD : ∀ v, v ∈ D → G.degree v = 3)
    (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hportsE : xE ∈ E ∧ yE ∈ E ∧ xE ≠ yE)
    (hboundaryE :
      ∀ v, v ∈ E → ∀ w, w ∉ E → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hexactE :
      ∀ v, v ∈ E → (G.Adj v r ↔ v = xE ∨ v = yE))
    (hcubicE : ∀ v, v ∈ E → G.degree v = 3)
    (hcard : D.card = E.card) :
    (G.induce (↑D : Set V)).edgeFinset.card =
      (G.induce (↑E : Set V)).edgeFinset.card

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.two_port_side_card_bound
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.two_port_side_card_bound
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D : Finset V) (r x y : V)
    (hr : r ∉ D)
    (hports : x ∈ D ∧ y ∈ D ∧ x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj r x ∧ G.Adj r y)
    (hboundary :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r) :
    Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * D.card + 1

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.two_twoPort_sides_balanced
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.two_twoPort_sides_balanced
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (M : MinimalCounterexample G)
    (D E : Finset V) (r : V)
    (xD yD xE yE : V)
    (hrD : r ∉ D) (hrE : r ∉ E)
    (hdisj : Disjoint D E)
    (hcover : insert r (D ∪ E) = Finset.univ)
    (hboundaryD :
      ∀ v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, w ∉ D → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hboundaryE :
      ∀ v, v ∈ E → ∀ w, w ∉ E → G.Adj v w → w = r)
    (hportsD :
      xD ∈ D ∧ yD ∈ D ∧ xD ≠ yD ∧ G.Adj r xD ∧ G.Adj r yD)
    (hportsE :
      xE ∈ E ∧ yE ∈ E ∧ xE ≠ yE ∧ G.Adj r xE ∧ G.Adj r yE) :
    D.card = E.card

name: Erdos64.twoRootDeletedComponents_partition
statement:
theorem twoRootDeletedComponents_partition
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (r : V) (C₁ C₂ : Finset V)
    (_hGconn : G.Connected)
    (hC₁nonempty : C₁.Nonempty)
    (hC₂nonempty : C₂.Nonempty)
    (hr₁ : r ∉ C₁)
    (hr₂ : r ∉ C₂)
    (hC₁conn : (G.induce (↑C₁ : Set V)).Connected)
    (hC₂conn : (G.induce (↑C₂ : Set V)).Connected)
    (hcross : ∀ x, x ∈ C₁ → ∀ y, y ∈ C₂ → ¬G.Adj x y)
    (hattach₁ : ∃ x, x ∈ C₁ ∧ G.Adj r x)
    (hattach₂ : ∃ x, x ∈ C₂ ∧ G.Adj r x)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint C₁ C₂)
    (hcover : C₁ ∪ C₂ = Finset.univ.erase r) :
    ∃ A B : Finset V,
      A = {r} ∪ C₁ ∧
      B = {r} ∪ C₂ ∧
      C₁ ∪ C₂ = Finset.univ.erase r ∧
      Disjoint C₁ C₂ ∧
      A ∩ B = ({r} : Finset V) ∧
      A ∪ B = Finset.univ ∧
      A.Nonempty ∧ B.Nonempty ∧
      r ∈ A ∧ r ∈ B ∧
      C₁.Nonempty ∧ C₂.Nonempty ∧
      (G.induce (↑C₁ : Set V)).Connected ∧
      (G.induce (↑C₂ : Set V)).Connected ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ C₁ → ∀ y, y ∈ C₂ → ¬G.Adj x y) ∧
      (∃ x, x ∈ C₁ ∧ G.Adj r x) ∧
      (∃ x, x ∈ C₂ ∧ G.Adj r x)

name: Erdos64.CubicTwoTerminalCompletion.completion_cycle
statement:
theorem CubicTwoTerminalCompletion.completion_cycle
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (T : CubicTwoTerminalCompletion G) :
    (T.gadget.append T.returnPath.reverse).IsCycle ∧
      (T.gadget.append T.returnPath.reverse).length =
        T.gadget.length + T.returnPath.length

name: Erdos64.CubicTwoTerminalCompletion.terminal_length_equation
Erdos64.exists_unequal_cut_root_side
statement:
theorem exists_unequal_cut_root_side
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (_hcritical : IsSubgraphCritical G)
    (A B : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hpartition : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hinter : A ∩ B = ({r} : Finset V))
    (hnocross : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, y ∈ B → y ≠ r → ¬G.Adj x y)
    (hrootA : 2 ≤ internalDegree G A r)
    (_hrootB : 2 ≤ internalDegree G B r)
    (hAB : A.card < B.card) :
    ∃ (S : Finset V) (root : {v : V // v ∈ S}),
      (∀ v, v ∈ S → v ≠ root.1 → ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∈ S) ∧
      2 ≤ internalDegree G S root.1 ∧
      2 * S.card - 1 < Fintype.card V

name: Erdos64.MinimalCounterexample.false_of_unequal_cut_root_partition
statement:
theorem MinimalCounterexample.false_of_unequal_cut_root_partition
    {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (minimalCounterexample : EdgeMinimalCounterexample G)
    (A B : Finset V) (r : V)
    (hpartition : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hinter : A ∩ B = ({r} : Finset V))
    (hnocross : ∀ x, x ∈ A → x ≠ r →
      ∀ y, y ∈ B → y ≠ r → ¬G.Adj x y)
    (hrootA : 2 ≤ internalDegree G A r)
    (hrootB : 2 ≤ internalDegree G B r)
    (hAB : A.card < B.card) :
    False
